answer: Like a juniper’s growth rings recording local climate, each agent accrues a tamper-evident history of fine-grained local interactions that downscales its coarse global reputation into costly-to-fake detail. Aggregating these histories across the ocean of agent activity, an anomaly detector flags identities whose local behavior diverges from regional baselines, so a sybil must forge consistent micro-histories across many contexts. This raises attacker cost to sustained, coherent synthetic activity, though its limit is that patient adversaries can slowly build plausible histories.
